scope: An explicit fixed demo catalog; all ten broader use-case requirements remain unchanged.
hypotheses: Equal class/speaker training mass improves unfamiliar-human command recall versus uniform sampling at matched capacity and update budget.
Cross-speaker same-command contrastive positives improve macro-speaker recall beyond balancing alone.
A separate wake-owner gate reduces wrong-speaker acceptance while retaining at least 95 percent of otherwise correct accepted genuine commands.

training.augmentation: none in this first matched ablation
training.selection: dev macro-speaker positive raw recall, then fewer negative errors, then micro recall; ties retain earlier epoch

speaker_policy.threshold_status: must be chosen using separate human calibration pairs
speaker_policy.window_coverage: must be established by the backend; the policy does not discover speech boundaries

evidence_boundaries: Numerical fixtures are not human recordings or speaker-verification measurements.
Paired-crop replay bypasses wake detection and endpoint capture.
Speaker model, overlap model, continuity segmentation, acoustic calibration and live integration are not supplied by the policy helper.
The new keyword model has not been acoustically trained, exported, integrated into SpeakerUI or qualified.
No observed accuracy gain, pretrained speaker deployment, physical Pi measurement, or provider action is claimed.
Repeated combinations of the same recordings/speakers are statistically dependent.
